==Mythos Source==
Hunting Horrors first appeared in ''The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath'' (1927), written by H.P. Lovecraft. They are more fully described in ''The Lurker at the Threshold'' (1945), written by August Derlerth and H.P. Lovecraft.
